title: The Pond Puzzle
intro: This quiz follows Maya and Theo as they learn about the frog life cycle and metamorphosis.

questions.prompt: Where do frogs begin their life cycle?
questions.explanation: Frogs begin their life cycle in water.

questions.prompt: What protects the developing frog embryos inside the eggs?
questions.explanation: Jelly surrounding the eggs protects the developing frog embryos.

questions.prompt: What major changes happen as a tadpole becomes a froglet?
choices: It grows wings and loses its legs
It grows legs, develops lungs, and its tail becomes smaller
It grows fur and leaves the water immediately
It becomes larger but keeps the same body shape
questions.explanation: As a tadpole becomes a froglet, it grows legs, develops lungs, and its tail becomes smaller.

choices: A major change in body form as an animal grows
The movement of frogs between ponds
questions.explanation: Metamorphosis is a major change in body form as an animal grows.
